models.title: 1940s Rooftop Camouflage Prop House — Canvas & Timber Stage Set
models.author: TwistFrame Lab
models.description: Original WWII decoy house like those built on aircraft-plant roofs c.1944: painted canvas over a timber stud frame, shingle-painted canvas roof, painted windows, open braced back. 8.8 × 5.0 × 9.1 m, 16k tris, 2K PBR, Y-up GLB. Separate movable parts. Film, games, dioramas.
models.historicalBasis: Boeing Plant 2 rooftop camouflage (99% Invisible, Cascade PBS, Warfare History Network, Flying magazine): canvas over light timber frames, painted roofs/streets.
